pages.title: Living vine that carries you
text: A Vine Lift is a pad of living vine. Put one on every floor of a tower or a mine shaft, one above the other in the **same column**, and they find each other on their own. No linking, no power.
- **Jump** on a lift to rise to the next lift above.
- **Sneak** on a lift to sink to the next lift below.
Any number can be stacked; each jump or sneak goes one lift at a time, skipping the empty floors between. A lift looks up to **48 blocks** each way.
The next lift needs two blocks of room above it to stand in; a lift with a ceiling on it is passed over, so you never arrive inside a wall.
